      local function fn_cheapest_first_1(arg1_452)
        local res_sort_cheapest_first_1 = tbl_slot_autoselect_1.ShopPriority
        table.sort(arg1_452, function(p_price_1, p_price_2)
          if _bUY == "Cheapest first" then
            if p_price_1.Price ~= p_price_2.Price then
              return p_price_1.Price < p_price_2.Price
            end
          elseif _bUY == "Most expensive first" then
            if p_price_1.Price ~= p_price_2.Price then
              return p_price_1.Price > p_price_2.Price
            end
          else
            local stars_710, stars_711 = p_price_1.Stars or 0, p_price_2.Stars or 0
            if stars_710 ~= stars_711 then
              return stars_710 > stars_711
            end
            if p_price_1.Price ~= p_price_2.Price then
              return p_price_1.Price < p_price_2.Price
            end
          end
          return false
        end)
      end
